post_r7_5_3_architecture_reset.name: V1PLUS_ARCHITECTURE_RESET
post_r7_5_3_architecture_reset.scope: Design a successor that must independently satisfy stability eligibility and strategic non-inferiority/superiority; this scope is not R7.5.3 remediation.

phase2a_strategy_memory_capacity_ablatio.consequence: Do not blindly escalate Strategy memory; upstream Advantage/chance trajectory remains the primary diagnostic target.

advantage_trajectory_forensic.consequence: Target/sign noise is already severe on shared exact infosets and is amplified into seed-dependent Advantage behavior/trajectory feedback. Compression or memory escalation alone is not the first remedy.

phase2b0_policy_algebra_screen.purpose: Read-only screen whether averaging the four raw Advantage estimates before the discontinuous regret-matching transform reduces cross-seed behavior divergence while holding uncertainty epsilon fixed.

strategic_strength_rule: No candidate may advance on stability alone. Any stable V1+ successor must separately demonstrate strategic non-inferiority or superiority to the certified stable V1 control under precommitted paired evaluation.
